source.title: Black Housing Dye - Item - World of Warcraft
source.author: Tequima (Wowhead player comment)

notes: Patch 12.1: Azeroot is the source-listed Midnight herb for Black Housing Dye. The source states 10 herbs yield one dye; no probabilities inferred. Blizzard confirmed the former pigment intermediary was retired: https://www.bluetracker.gg/wow/topic/us-en/2317861-i-bet-youre-dyeing-to-hear-about-this/. Herb quality unspecified, so giveItemID is null. This is housing dye crafting, not Midnight milling.
where: Housing dye station in player housing neighborhood
requirements: Classic Alchemy or Classic Inscription; housing dye station; consumes 10 of the named herb (rank unspecified).
